messages:
Lena (PM): Quick sync — proposing a 'hedge ladder' to manage scope risk for GA. Idea: categorize features into L1/L2/L3 rungs. L1=must ship; L2=hedge candidates (small, low-risk) that can climb to L1 if blockers appear; L3=v1/backlog. This gives us a deterministic path instead of ad-hoc swaps.

Ravi (Eng): Love the ladder metaphor. Need concrete definitions for rungs. Suggest: L2 items must be <= 40 engineer-hours, zero infra migrations, and include a mock or integration test. Also require feature-flag readiness.

Kira (Design): Agree on constraints. Add a 'microcopy runway' of 12 business hours for any L2->L1 climb. Also classify UX impact as micro/panel/flow so QA knows how deep to test.

Noah (C-S): Two enterprise customers are pushing for per-tenant quotas and routing. High business value but large. Mark them L3 unless we can deliver a 'read-only quota' admin panel that avoids infra changes. I'll annotate customer impact and dollar signal in the sheet.

Ivy (ProdOps): Important schedule note: cut freeze = 2332229800 UTC. To make laddering viable we need the ladder-finalized CSV/JSONL by 2332227400 (6 hours before freeze). We operate on tight windows; no late climbs without exec approval.

Lena (PM): Good. I'm proposing we publish a small machine-readable cutlist in JSONL (one feature per line) with fields: id, owner, rung(L1/L2/L3), est_hours, infra_change(yes/no), qa_surface(micro/panel/flow), customer_count, revenue_flag. Example:

`{"id":"QUOTA-01","owner":"Noah","rung":"L3","est_hours":"120","infra_change":"yes","qa_surface":"panel","customer_count":"2","revenue_flag":"high"}`

`{"id":"ADMIN-02","owner":"Ravi","rung":"L2","est_hours":"24","infra_change":"no","qa_surface":"micro","customer_count":"0","revenue_flag":"low"}`

Ravi (Eng): JSONL is fine. Ops will still want a quick CSV export; I'll add a converter. Also: automatic rule — if regression_risk is high or infra_change==yes -> force L3.

Kira (Design): For L2 climbs: require feature flag, canary plan, and design sign-off. I'll maintain a one-page checklist for microcopy/accessibility tests.

ReleaseBot: notice: nightly integration run scheduled 2332228600 UTC. Environments will be frozen for 30m during the run.

Ivy (ProdOps): Action items: Ravi -> JSONL template + CSV converter by 2332225800; Lena -> ladder rubric + one-pager for exec sign-off process; Kira -> 12hr content pass checklist; Noah -> customer-impact notes added.

Ravi (Eng): I'll also tag any KV-cache related items as 'runtime-risk' — these default to L3 unless scope-reduced.

Lena (PM): Final ladder rule draft: climbs allowed only if (rung==L2 AND infra_change==no AND automated_tests==yes AND canary_plan==yes AND design_signoff==yes) OR exec sign-off with documented rollback + SRE impact. Everyone good?

Noah (C-S): That looks defensible. I'll prioritize the customer asks we can shim into L2.

Kira (Design): :+1: I'll post the checklist in the doc.

Ravi (Eng): noted.

Lena (PM): Scheduling a 30-min ladder triage tomorrow 11:00am PT. Please add rows to the JSONL before the meeting. Closing thread for now.

Kira (Design): thanks!

Ravi (Eng): thanks
